findings.title: Header-spoofable admin authorization enables privilege escalation on new admin routes
findings.exploitability: Remote, unauthenticated (if API is directly reachable or trusted-header boundary is bypassed)
findings.blast_radius: Attacker can execute admin-only operations (prompt template create/update/delete, memory feedback, provider/model admin actions).
findings.issue: Identity and role are derived from client-controlled headers (`x-user-role`, `x-user-id`). `AdminOnlyGuard` also accepts role from raw headers. Any caller can self-assert admin by sending `x-user-role: admin`.

findings.title: New RAG quality endpoints are unauthenticated and allow telemetry tampering / operational intelligence disclosure
findings.blast_radius: Attackers can forge quality metrics, skew release gates, and query run replay completeness by runId.
findings.issue: `/api/v1/rag/quality/*` endpoints were added without guards. `POST /report` mutates quality state, `GET /replay/:runId` reveals run-stage completeness.

findings.title: Prompt template listing endpoint leaks runtime prompt content without authorization context
findings.category: OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control / A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures (sensitive config exposure)
findings.blast_radius: Prompt contents and scope metadata can be harvested and used to jailbreak/evade guardrails across RAG SQL generation.
findings.issue: `GET /api/v1/settings/prompts` has no guard and no actor-scoped filtering; response model includes template `content`.

findings.title: RAG context and template overlay are injected into LLM prompt as trusted text; retrieval snippets are emitted into trace/output
findings.category: OWASP A03:2021 Injection / A04:2021 Insecure Design / A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.exploitability: Remote authenticated user controlling ingested content or template text
findings.blast_radius: Prompt-injection can bias SQL generation; retrieval text snippets can leak sensitive document fragments through trace and API responses.
findings.issue: Untrusted retrieval chunk content and runtime template content are concatenated directly into prompts and then partly echoed via trace/delivery paths.

findings.title: RAG quality mutation endpoint lacks DTO validation and uses unbounded in-memory accumulation
findings.category: OWASP A04:2021 Insecure Design / A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.blast_radius: Memory growth and metric integrity degradation can affect release gating decisions.
findings.issue: Controller accepts a TypeScript interface (no runtime validation by `ValidationPipe`), and service appends records indefinitely in arrays.

highlights.risk: Server-side DoS risk in App Router environments.
Template code-injection vector in vulnerable usage patterns.
Prototype pollution/ReDoS when parsing attacker-controlled sheets.

tooling: rg patterns over tracked diff files
secrets_scan.result: No confirmed hardcoded live credentials in tracked diff; matches were mostly schema fields/tests/docs placeholders.

line_checks.evidence: Actor role/id are sourced from request headers.
Guard accepts admin role from actor and raw/request headers.
Template overlay and retrieval context are directly concatenated into prompt text.
